scope: Measured candidate delivery derivatives only. No optimizer, source, coastal or publication output files changed.
projection_origin: Parent measured current Jhoti base plus responsive variants; not a hosted measurement.

selected_jpeg.creator: Ilya Mauter
selected_jpeg.observed_credit_phrase: Original photograph; full frame in the article. Responsive copies are resized; previews may be cropped.
selected_jpeg.necessary_credit_change: Keep creator, source and licence links; replace the unique original-photograph assertion with explicit full-frame resizing/compression for delivery. Preserve the accurate responsive-preview wording.
selected_jpeg.necessary_og_change: Guard the exact image URL and unique current 2304 × 1728 tags, then set 1600 × 1200.
selected_jpeg.visual_review: Personally inspected full-frame source and candidate separately at 1000-pixel width. Worshipper, offerings, pool edges and composition remain legible, without an obvious material framing or colour problem at that scale. This is lossy resizing/compression, not pixel equality.
selected_jpeg.metadata_limit: ICC bytes match; IPTC/XMP are absent in both; orientation 1 is retained. EXIF serialization changes from 11,384 to 11,376 bytes and has not been independently audited tag by tag; do not claim exact EXIF preservation.

checks: Re-read the existing eight-path JPEG and exact PNG allowlists. The three proposed paths are outside those allowlists.
Re-ran the existing losslessPNG function for both selected PNGs; its decoded RGBA equality, dimensions and original non-IDAT metadata guards passed.
All three current public source hashes match the existing publication copies and remain unchanged after measurement.
Opened the current Commons file page and checked attribution/licence/source dimensions against the existing image record.
Inspected actual existing Taptapani publication credit and sharing tags.

alternatives.lossless_only: The previously measured remaining small PNG set cannot meet the required roughly 635,677 bytes plus HTML growth. Two selected lossless additions total 96,620 bytes.
alternatives.jpeg_rejected: Taptapani 2048/95 becomes 156,381 bytes larger; 1600/90 saves only 480,396 bytes. Osakothi 2048/95 saves 280,487 bytes and is not selected.
alternatives.unselected_exploration: A 1440/80 Taptapani buffer was measured before the parent selected 1600/85 and asked to stop lower-quality exploration. It is not selected or visually approved.

implementation_guards: Add only the selected JPEG and two exact PNG paths; keep all previous entries/settings unchanged.
Preserve repository and coastal originals, existing source records and original image credits.
Require exact caption/source and sharing-dimension matches; fail rather than silently transform an unrelated page.
Do not broaden responsive-image changes, retune other photographs or claim lossless JPEG output.
Separately review root implementation, real transformed package and final desktop/mobile presentation.
limits: The 77,363-byte projection precedes HTML growth and any other package change. Actual final Linux payload must pass the unchanged hosting gate.
Local encoder results do not establish hosted-byte identity.
No build, website edit, browser interaction, live check or publication occurred in this diagnosis.
This is a proposal assessment, not an independent approval of an implementation that does not yet exist.
verdict: Selected three-path delivery-only proposal is defensible for implementation and separate final review, subject to actual package capacity and the stated metadata/credit guards.
